project.title: Launch of New Tiered Membership Sales Program
project.objective: Design and roll out a tiered membership program and sales playbook to increase recurring revenue and improve member retention.
deliverables: Defined tiered membership structure with pricing and benefits
Standardized membership sales playbook and objection-handling guide
Prospect targeting list and outreach cadence for membership sales
Membership performance tracking sheet with key sales metrics
Internal FAQ and policy guideline for membership terms and conditions
constraints: Program must be launch-ready within 21 days
Pricing and terms must comply with existing company policies and consumer protection rules
No changes to core billing system; only process and communication updates allowed
Sales materials must be usable across online, phone, and in-person channels
All documentation must be available in at least two languages

risks.risk: Sales team confusion about new membership tiers leading to inconsistent pitches.
risks.mitigation: Create concise playbook, run short enablement sessions, and maintain a living FAQ in the channel.

risks.risk: Pricing or benefit promises conflict with company policies or consumer protection rules.
risks.mitigation: Membership manager validates all tiers and scripts with legal and finance before launch.

risks.risk: Overly complex tier structure reduces conversion rates.
risks.mitigation: Limit initial launch to 2–3 tiers and validate with quick customer feedback from early calls.

risks.risk: Lack of tracking makes it hard to measure program impact.
risks.mitigation: Define mandatory fields and cadence for updating the membership performance tracking sheet.

themes.why_relevant: Core of the project; tiers must be clear, attractive, and operationally feasible.
Directly impacts conversion and consistency across commercial sales representatives.
Determines how efficiently the team fills the membership pipeline.
Membership terms must align with company policies and consumer protection rules.
Needed to iterate on tiers, pricing, and messaging after launch.

backlog.task: Draft initial tiered membership structure with pricing and core benefits
definition_of_done: 2–3 membership tiers defined with clear benefits
Pricing bands aligned with finance guidance
Draft shared in channel and open for comments

backlog.task: Review membership tiers for policy and consumer protection compliance
definition_of_done: Tiers checked against company policies and consumer protection rules
Any risky wording or benefits adjusted
Compliance notes added to internal FAQ

backlog.task: Create membership sales pitch script and short call outline
definition_of_done: Script covers opening, discovery, pitch, and close
Includes at least 5 common objections with responses
Validated by membership manager and shared with team

backlog.task: Define target customer segments and build initial prospect list
definition_of_done: 3–5 priority segments described with key needs
Prospect list of at least 50 accounts compiled
List structured in tracking sheet with segment tags

backlog.task: Set outreach cadence and channel mix for membership offers
definition_of_done: Cadence defined for calls, email, and digital outreach
Touchpoints mapped for first 3 weeks of campaign
Cadence documented in guideline and agreed in channel

backlog.task: Prepare internal membership FAQ and policy guideline
definition_of_done: FAQ covers eligibility, upgrades, downgrades, and cancellations
Policy constraints clearly listed for sales team
Document linked in channel and versioned
Top 10 objections captured from past sales experience
Concise responses aligned with membership policy
Cheat sheet formatted for easy use during calls

backlog.task: Set up membership performance tracking sheet and fields
definition_of_done: Sheet includes leads, tier, status, revenue, and source
Update cadence agreed with sales team
Test entries added and validated for reporting

backlog.task: Pilot membership pitch with a small group of existing customers
definition_of_done: At least 10 pilot calls completed
Outcomes and feedback logged in tracking sheet
Key learnings summarized in channel

backlog.task: Refine tiers and scripts based on pilot feedback
definition_of_done: Feedback from T9 reviewed and categorized
Adjustments to tiers or messaging documented
Updated materials shared and old versions archived

backlog.task: Align with marketing on external messaging for membership program
definition_of_done: Key messages and value props agreed with marketing
No conflicts between sales script and marketing copy
Summary of alignment posted in channel

backlog.task: Define weekly reporting format for membership sales performance
definition_of_done: Standard template for weekly updates agreed
Fields map to performance tracking sheet
First sample report created and validated

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on membership tier structure, pricing, and policy constraints.
threads_plan.trigger: Membership manager shares first draft of tiered membership structure.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the number of membership tiers and their core benefits.
Confirm final pricing bands and any discount rules for launch.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Finalize sales script, objection handling, and pre-call checklist.
threads_plan.trigger: Commercial sales representative posts draft script and cheat sheet for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Lock in the standard membership pitch script for launch.
Agree on the final list of top objections and approved responses.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define target segments, outreach cadence, and prospect list priorities.
threads_plan.trigger: Team starts building the initial membership prospect list.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select priority customer segments for the first 3 weeks.
Approve outreach cadence and channel mix for membership offers.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Run pilot, capture feedback, and refine tiers and messaging.
threads_plan.trigger: First round of pilot membership calls is completed.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Decide which changes to tiers or messaging are required post-pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on reporting format and weekly update ritual for membership performance.
threads_plan.trigger: Membership manager shares draft tracking sheet and summary template.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm the weekly reporting template and update cadence.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in where each participant posts yesterday's membership activity and today's focus.
Weekly membership performance summary using the standard template before end of week.
Post-pilot review thread after each pilot batch to log learnings and proposed tweaks.
Pre-launch go/no-go checklist review one day before official membership program launch.
